chunks: Another text: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Hajjal, who said: Sa'id ibn Abi al-Jahm narrated to us, from Nasr ibn Qaboos, who said: I said to Abu Ibrahim Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them both):

I asked your father (peace be upon him), 'Who will be after you?' He informed me that you were it. When Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) passed away, the people went right and left, and my friends and I believed in you. So inform me, who will be after you?' He said: 'My son Ali (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.مَنْ يَكُونُ بَعْدَكَ: Who will be after you (succession query)

ai.seo_question: Who did Imam Musa ibn Ja'far appoint as his successor?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the continuity of the Imamate through the explicit designation (Nass) of Imam Musa al-Kazim, who confirmed his son Musa al-Dhahabi (Imam al-Jawad) as his successor before passing the mantle to Ali al-Rida. It underscores the Shia doctrine of clear, hereditary succession within the progeny of the Prophet, contrasting the certainty of the Ahl al-Bayt with the confusion of the general populace during the transition periods. The text serves as a key evidence for the infallible chain of Imams, emphasizing that leadership is a divine appointment rather than a matter of popular consensus.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-26 In another tradition it is narrated that (The author of the book narrated) my father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’d ibn Abdullah quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Hajjal, on the authority of Sa’eed ibn Abil Jahm, on the authority of Nasr ibn Qaboos that he told Abi Ibrahim Musa ibn Ja’far (s), “I asked your father (s) ‘Who is going to be your successor?’ Your father (s) informed me that you were his successor. When Abu Abdillah (s) passed away each group of people went on different ways. But my friends and I believed in you. Then please inform me about whom your successor will be.”
Musa ibn Ja’far (s) said, “My son Ali.”
